description: This file defines interfaces for shared memory buffer management within the Rialto media server component, including factory creation and buffer operations such as mapping, unmapping, clearing data, and accessing buffer properties.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Interface for shared memory buffer operations, including mapping, unmapping, clearing data, and accessing buffer properties.

classes.name: ISharedMemoryBufferFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating shared memory buffer instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISharedMemoryBufferFactory instance.
